about:
Gulfstream Steel & Supply was founded in 1990 in Holly Ridge, North Carolina, as a locally owned and operated metals service center. The company began as a dependable source of metal materials and services for the eastern North Carolina region.

The company maintains an extensive inventory of carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized steel, and PVC pipe and fittings, and provides a range of value‑added processing services. Its capabilities include structural sawing, mitre and CNC cutting, plate burning and beveling up to 14‑inch thickness, CNC machining on HAAS VF9 and VF4 mills and a Quickmill gantry center, sheet and coil shearing, forming, and punching, as well as pipe and tube cutting, drilling, and slotting. An on‑site blast shop prepares surfaces with black beauty and steel shot media, and a dedicated hose shop assembles custom hydraulic and pneumatic hose assemblies. Gulfstream also operates a fleet of 24‑foot Freightliners, a 28‑foot tandem‑axle International, and a 53‑foot Volvo for delivery across southeastern North Carolina.

Gulfstream serves industrial, agricultural, manufacturing, MRO, and construction customers, with a particular focus on U.S. military installations, law‑enforcement agencies, first‑responder units, and K‑9 training facilities. The company has worked with prime vendors such as Darley Defense on training‑solution projects.

The business emphasizes local hiring, including veterans, and promotes next‑day delivery on most stock items with free local delivery on orders over $500. Its differentiation rests on a large regional inventory, in‑house processing equipment, and a commitment to coastal‑environment durability through quality control and corrosion‑resistant coatings.
